fixed_findings.before: A generation cancelled while a destination read was outstanding still deleted or overwrote one local file, then reported directoryCancelled.
fixed_findings.after: Recheck cancellation after awaited reads/parent/handle acquisition and before write-stream mutation or close. Abort acquired uncommitted streams; already committed operations are not rolled back.

fixed_findings.before: A generated ARM program transmitted 0x42 then disabled TX within 128 ticks. The real core emitted the byte, but Worker discarded it using the current transmitter readiness.
fixed_findings.after: Explicitly paired decoded UART2 transport forwards already emitted bytes. The receiving side still checks enabled infrared reception; internal loopback does not enter the external transmit queue.

checkpoint v6 delta bounds/order, immutable ROM identity and validation before mutation
